spans.s: any ceremony in which offerings or oblations are presented, Yājñ.; Ragh.; Rājat. &c.
याग—कण्टक m. ‘sacrifice-thorn’, a bad sacrificer (who does not know the god, metre, glossarial explanation, Brāhman, Ṛṣi, Kṛt and Taddhita affixes of the Vedic verses), L.
याग—कर्मन् n. a sacrificial rite or ceremony, MārkP.
याग—काल m. time of sacrifice, Jyot.
याग—मण्डप m. n. ‘hall for sacrifices’, a temple, Cat.
याग—मय mf(ई)n. consisting of sacrifices, L.
याग—संतान m. N. of Jayanta (son of Indra), L.
याग—सम्प्रदान n. the recipient of a sacrifice, Kāś. on Pāṇ. iv, 2, 24.
याग—सूत्र n. the sacrificial cord, sacred thread, Up. (cf. यज्ञ-सूत्र).
